name: Blanc
statusNote: Actively developed, with stable desktop releases distributed through GitHub Releases.

macos.note: A signed and notarized Apple Silicon macOS build is published.

windows.note: A signed Windows NSIS installer is published.

android.note: No Android release is published; the official privacy policy says mobile is still in development.

ios.note: No iOS release is published; the official privacy policy says mobile is still in development.

availability.cpuNotes: The v1.17.0 release provides an Apple Silicon macOS build and 64-bit Windows and Linux builds.
availability.installMethod: Direct download from the official site or GitHub Releases.

foundation.codeLicense: MIT for Bananify-owned code, with separately licensed third-party material and reserved trademarks

telemetry.note: Pseudonymous usage measurement is presented on during first-run setup, cannot send before the choice is saved, and can be disabled before continuing or later in Settings.

trackerBlocking.note: Hash-pinned EasyList and EasyPrivacy snapshots power built-in network and cosmetic blocking.

fingerprintingProtections.note: Blanc does not document a general anti-fingerprinting mode or claim to block every fingerprinting technique.

privacy.privateWindows: Private tabs share a separate non-persistent session for the app run and are excluded from history, session restore, reopen-closed-tab, and Profile Sync.
privacy.defaultSearchEngine: DuckDuckGo by default; Google, Bing, and Brave Search are configurable alternatives

vpnOrProxy.note: Blanc documents that it connects directly to sites and does not proxy or anonymize browsing traffic.

manifestV2.note: Blanc deliberately ships no browser-extension runtime.

manifestV3.note: Blanc deliberately ships no browser-extension runtime.

extensions.limitations: No browser extensions are supported. The optional macOS 1Password SDK integration is narrow and is not an extension runtime.

nativeContentBlocking.note: Ad and tracker blocking runs in the browser session rather than through an extension.

verticalTabs.note: An optional resizable vertical tab rail is built in.

tabTrees.note: No tree-style tab hierarchy is documented; named flat tab groups are a separate feature.

workspaces.note: Named Workspaces save and restore named sets of tabs and groups; creating one requires an active Blanc Patron subscription.

profiles.note: Named local profiles isolate site data, history, Favorites, downloads, and remembered permissions.

splitView.note: Glance displays a second current-window tab beside the main page as a temporary reference.

sidebar.note: The optional vertical tab rail provides a left-side tab surface.

readerMode.note: A built-in reader mode is not documented.

commandPalette.note: The Island command palette supports navigation, search, tab switching, and slash commands.

sync.note: Optional end-to-end-encrypted Profile Sync covers Favorites and eligible settings; open-tab sharing is separately opt-in.

translation.note: Built-in page translation is not documented.

pwa.note: A web-app installation flow is not documented.

assistant.note: Blanc ships no built-in AI assistant.

summarization.note: Blanc ships no built-in AI summarization feature.

agenticActions.note: Blanc is not an agent browser and ships no agentic browsing actions.

aiSearch.note: Blanc ships no AI answer engine.

contentGeneration.note: Blanc ships no built-in AI content generation.

modelChoice.note: Blanc has no built-in AI models to select.

aiPrivacyControls.note: Blanc has no built-in AI features requiring AI-specific privacy controls.

crossTabContext.note: Blanc does not give an AI system cross-tab context.

voiceMultimodal.note: Blanc ships no built-in voice or multimodal AI interface.
